overview.oneLineTake: A three-headed monster of surging bond yields, geopolitical oil shock, and AI trade fragility is forcing a defensive rotation and raising the probability of a volatility expansion.
themes: Bond Yield Shock: 10-year Treasury yield surging above 5.2%, hitting multi-decade highs, driving a broad risk-off rotation and pressuring tech/growth stocks.
Geopolitical Oil Spike: US-Iran tensions escalating after Trump rejects ceasefire, crude oil surging, and a potential US diesel export ban adding to energy-driven inflation fears.
AI Trade Under Pressure: Rising yields and debt costs threatening AI capex; Michael Burry and others calling a near-term correction; Oracle downgrade; bond market "chicken" with Treasury.
risks: Credit Contagion: CMBS losses hitting AAA tranches, high-yield debt deluge overwhelming investors, and corporate debt maturities testing borrowers as rates rise.
Midterm Election Uncertainty: Options pricing muted moves, but political risk (Senate tossups, House control) could trigger a volatility spike post-election.
Consumer Strain: Consumer sentiment near record lows, leisure sector stress, and immigration crackdown disrupting labor supply (cattle slaughter, housing).
